feeds.title: My Lovable Pest
feeds.description: Two dads finding hope, humor & heart in their journey of raising a 5-year-old with great potential & prognosis of at-risk FASD. Follow My Blog Get new content delivered directly to your inbox.

feeds.title: NolaPapa Blog
feeds.description: Meet Erik Alexander and his husband, a dynamic couple from New Orleans, Louisiana. They are proud parents to two independently assertive daughters and an eager baby boy who is always trying to keep up with his sisters. Their blog is a vibrant space where they discuss hot topics such as recipes, gardening, parenting in today's ever-changing world, and much more. Through their posts, they aim to share their experiences, offer support, and inspire others in the LGBTQ community and beyond.

feeds.title: Gay NYC Dad
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Mitchell. I am a 61 years young gay man with a spouse of 900+ years. We have an adopted (at birth) son currently in the NYC Public School system in the 12th grade. I am a Stay at home dad blogger raising a tweenage son in New York City. I cover articles on adoption, parenting, product reviews and more.

feeds.title: Proud Parenting
feeds.description: Proud Parenting shares love, commitment, and family values. LGBTQ Parents - Lesbian Moms & Gay Dads. Follow this website to see world's largest photo gallery of same-sex parents & their families.

feeds.title: Gay Parents To Be Blog
feeds.description: Read on about LGBT trending news, family building stories, legal advice and more from our LGBT voices team! Gay Parents To Be is an informational resource and a starting point for LGBTQ parenting. We strive to provide the best care for LGBTQ couples and individuals as they navigate all of their family building options.

feeds.title: Daddy and Dad
feeds.description: We're Jamie and Tom - also known as Daddy and Dad, blogging gay dads of two boys via adoption. Our aim is to enlight prospective adopters about the adoption process, in particular the stuff that happens after the kids are placed with their adoptive parents (or 'move in' as our boys affectionately call it).

feeds.title: Hound Mamas
feeds.description: Two moms, two hounds, and a baby. I'm Molly and my wife is Catch. We spent about 2 years trying to conceive our miracle baby and were finally successful after a round of IVF and a FET that resulted in a twin pregnancy. We lost one of our twins, but our miracle baby A stuck with us. Charlotte was born on July 23, 2015, and is the light of our life.

feeds.title: UNLIKELY DAD Blog
feeds.description: I'm Tom. I'm 33 and i am a dad to my wonderful son. An adoptive dad. A gay dad. Or maybe just a dad. I am blogging all about toddler life.

feeds.title: Lesbian in the Treehouse
feeds.description: I'm a lesbian mommy blogger navigating the beautiful, complex world of queer, polyamorous family life. I explore gender fluidity and parenting beyond binaries and celebrate love in its myriad forms. I share stories, laughter, and insights from our unconventional journey on gender-natural parenting. I hope to build an inclusive space filled with understanding and joy.

feeds.title: Daddy Squared
feeds.description: An Online Resource for Gay Dads. I'm here to tell the truth about parenting. The good, the bad and the 'we should have known.' While gay adoption has existed for many years, more and more of us are making a step forward from becoming 'the fun guncles' and have biological kids via IVF, which is still relatively new. Gay parenting is becoming even more common, and it's changing parenting forever. Let's document it.

feeds.title: Family is About Love
feeds.description: Love Deeply, Laugh Together, Be Kind To Each Other

feeds.title: Intended Parents.com » Gay Parenting
feeds.description: Intended Parents.com covers articles on gay parenting and surrogacy related news from around the world.

feeds.title: On Being a Gay Parent
feeds.description: I am a dad, who happens to be gay, with two amazing young adult children who have taught me, my partner, and their mom what grace, faith, hope, and love are all about. This is a blog site dedicated to issues concerning LGBTQ parents and our children, and LGBTQ children in our families, touching on issues of family, faith, and the culture in which we live.

feeds.title: The Gayby Project
feeds.description: One research obsessed post-punk political dyke and one wonder-endowed post-modern theater professor fall in love and decide to make some babies. Hilarity, awkwardness and, sometimes, tenderheartedness, ensues. Herein lies an adventure of queer infertility and making a family without biology on your side.

feeds.title: Mombian
feeds.description: Mombian is a lifestyle site for lesbian moms and other LGBT parents, offering a mix of parenting, politics, diversions, and resources for all our varied roles.

feeds.title: Meet the Wildes
feeds.description: Modern love story of two woman and their family. I'm Amber, and Meet the Wildes is a modern love story about two women who fell in love, and the family they made together. Mostly I write about my life with my partner, Kirsty, and our two sets of twins - boys born in October 14 and girls born in July 16.
